list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Tetramethylammonium salt of a cerium(III) divacant Dawson polyoxotungstate dimer

material_class.structural_family: Dimeric divacant Dawson polyoxotungstate with a Ce3 isosceles-triangle bridging cluster

properties.summary: Magnetic susceptibility indicates strong spin–orbit coupling and weak antiferromagnetic interactions among the three Ce3+ ions. Room-temperature photoluminescence is attributed to the Ce3+ 5d→4f transition.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The polyanion comprises two divacant {P2W16} Dawson units connected by an isosceles-triangle {Ce3} bridging cluster through Ce–O–W and Ce–O–P linkages.

synthesis.ph: Initially adjusted to 4.5; subsequently adjusted to approximately 7.4
synthesis.procedure: CeCl3·7H2O (0.074 g, 0.200 mmol) and isonicotinic acid (0.074 g, 0.600 mmol) were dissolved in water (20 mL). The mixture pH was adjusted to 4.5 with 6 M NaOH. Na12[P2W15O56]·24H2O (0.440 g, 0.100 mmol) was added rapidly with stirring to give a clear solution. The pH was then adjusted to approximately 7.4 with 6 M NaOH. The solution was heated at 60 °C for 1 h, tetramethylammonium chloride (0.110 g, 1.000 mmol) was added, and stirring continued for 20 min. The solution was cooled to room temperature and filtered; the filtrate was evaporated for two weeks to obtain yellow block crystals.
synthesis.time: 1 h heating; 20 min stirring after addition of tetramethylammonium chloride; filtrate evaporated for two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Conventional aqueous solution method; stirred solution
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooled to room temperature, filtered, and the filtrate evaporated for two weeks; yellow block crystals obtained.

title: A new dimeric polyoxometalate derivate assembled by divacant Dawson {P2W16} units and isosceles triangle {Ce3} cluster
